A special '''foam''' was employed by safety services to encase engines suspected of leaking [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a false radiation alarm at [[Montrol Spaceport]] on [[Gandle Ott]] caused the engines of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' to be smothered in radiation dampening foam.
